summary: List of links to the community’s social profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube, Discord…): round icons, pills with names, or a vertical list for footers. Each network’s icon and name come from the socialNetworks map, shared with ShareButtons.
whenToUse: “Follow us” footer column or contact section.
Social profiles of a speaker or member in a card or profile page.
Row of social icons in a dark hero (tone="inverse").
whenNotToUse: Sharing the current page: use ShareButtons.
Internal site navigation: use NavList or NavigationMenu.
A single text link: use Link.

props.name: items
props.description: Profiles to link, in display order. label replaces the text (accessible name in icon, visible label in pill and list); icon replaces the default icon.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the list for assistive technologies (e.g. “Follow us on social media”). Strongly recommended; alternatively use aria-labelledby pointing to the column heading.

props.name: variant
props.description: icon: round icon-only buttons; pill: icon + name; list: vertical icon + name list for footers.

props.name: size
props.description: Size, aligned with the control heights of the current density.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral on light surfaces, brand with the accent colors, inverse (glass, inherits the text color) for dark sections and heroes.

props.name: openInNewTab
props.description: http(s) links open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and announce it with hidden text (messages.opensInNewTab). mailto: and relative links stay in the same tab.

inherits: HTML attributes of the <ul> (id, style, data-*, aria-*); ref to the <ul>.

keyboard.action: Moves from one profile to the next.

accessibility: Semantic <ul>/<li> list: assistive technologies announce the number of profiles; give it a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
In the icon variant the accessible name is visually hidden text: messages.socialProfile(name), e.g. “GitHub profile”, or label.
Links that open in a new tab add “(opens in a new tab)” as hidden text.
Icons are decorative (aria-hidden); no transitions with prefers-reduced-motion; in forced-colors mode border and text use LinkText, focus uses Highlight.
On touch screens targets are at least 44 × 44 px.
responsive: icon and pill wrap when space runs out; list stays in a column.
With pointer: coarse the minimum touch area increases to 44 px.
customization: Tokens: --dc-color-action-neutral / --dc-color-action-secondary for the background, --dc-color-action-primary on hover (brand), --dc-density-control-height-* for sizes, --dc-color-focus-ring.
Icons: the installed version of lucide-react doesn’t include brand logos, so each network uses a generic glyph (e.g. CodeXml for GitHub, AtSign for X); pass icon on the item for an official logo.
Custom networks: any string as network uses the capitalized name and a generic link icon.
commonMistakes: Forgetting aria-label: an icon-only list is left without context.
Using tone="neutral" on a dark hero: use inverse.
Recoloring icons with official brand colors: it breaks contrast in dark mode and forced-colors mode.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Variants
examples.description: icon, pill, and list (with RSS and email).

examples.name: FooterInverse
examples.title: Dark “Follow us” footer
examples.description: List with aria-labelledby pointing to the column heading, inverse tone.

limits: No official brand logos: generic icons from lucide-react, replaceable with the icon prop.
No official brand colors: tones use semantic tokens only.
